heading.title: Third Division · Part I · Applications in Specified Cases

article.title: Thirty days.
article.content:
Article122Thirty days.

The Schedule  ·  Third Division—Applications · Part I—Applications in Specified Cases
To restore a suit or appeal or application for review or revision dismissed for default of appearance or for want of prosecution or for failure to pay costs of service of process or to furnish security for costs.
Period of limitationThirty days.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of dismissal.
